findings.summary: An ATProto-only account can never gain a second sign-in method, so the unlink refusal's own remedy is unreachable
findings.detail: The account is passwordless and its email is the deliberately non-routable did-...@atproto.invalid. ChangePassword returns ErrPasswordNotSet, RequestEmailChange returns ErrPasswordNotSet, and the password-reset mail can never be delivered. Losing the ATProto account therefore loses the Vidra account, and the 422 tells the user to do something no path allows.

findings.summary: /me/oauth-identities was mounted only when an OIDC provider was configured
findings.detail: ATProto login writes its DID into oauth_identities, so an ATProto-only instance answered 404 on list and unlink. Measured before and after on a live instance.

findings.summary: ATProto identity login could not reach a loopback PDS at all
findings.detail: resolveHandleHTTP hardcoded https://<handle> while the did:web branch already honoured the allowPrivate dev knob, and the did:plc directory was fixed to plc.directory. Both were relaxed under the existing loopback declaration; production is unchanged.

findings.summary: The 5xx error envelope scrubs the ATProto cross-post messages
findings.detail: 'Bluesky cross-posting is not enabled on this instance' (503) and 'could not reach the Bluesky server; please try again' (502) both arrive as the generic 'an unexpected error occurred'. The login endpoints escape it because ATProtoLoginError carries a machine code.

findings.summary: The Connected logins row identified an ATProto identity as 'Atproto' with 'no email recorded'
findings.detail: The handle is in the payload precisely so the owner can see which account is linked; the row showed neither it nor the network's name.

findings.summary: Account-level donation addresses have no profile surface
findings.detail: GET /users/{id}/donation-addresses is documented as the public projection for a profile page, but only SupportButton consumes it, and only via a channel's owner id. A creator with no channel exposes addresses no page renders.

findings.summary: A cross-post puts the watch URL only in the embed card, never in the post text
findings.detail: The record text is the video title; the link lives in app.bsky.embed.external.uri. Clients that do not render external embeds show a post with no link.

findings.summary: The callback's disabled check runs after the state-cookie check
findings.detail: With ATPROTO_LOGIN_ENABLED=false a bare callback answers 400 (missing state) rather than the typed 503.
